# Read data

```{r}

gpt2_object_preds_path <- "data/model_outputs/distributions/gpt2_wilcox2022_embed4_object_gap_continuation_results.csv"

gpt2_subject_preds_path <- "data/model_outputs/distributions/gpt2_wilcox2022_embed4_subject_gap_continuation_results.csv"

read_and_combine_dfs <- function(object_preds_path, subject_preds_path) {
  object_preds <- read_csv(object_preds_path)
  
  object_preds <- object_preds %>%
    mutate(
      wh = if_else(str_detect(condition, "^\\+wh"), "yes", "no"),
      gap = if_else(str_detect(condition, "no_gap$"), "no", "yes")
    )
  
  subject_preds <- read_csv(subject_preds_path)
  
  subject_preds <- subject_preds %>%
    mutate(
      wh = if_else(str_detect(condition, "^\\+wh"), "yes", "no"),
      gap = if_else(str_detect(condition, "no_gap$"), "no", "yes")
    )
  
  
  object_preds <- data.frame(
    "id" = object_preds$sentence_id, 
    "wh" = as_factor(object_preds$wh), 
    "embed" = as_factor(object_preds$embedding_level), 
    "correct" = as.integer(object_preds$correct),
    "gap_type" = "object")
  
  subject_preds <- data.frame(
    "id" = subject_preds$sentence_id, 
    "wh" = as_factor(subject_preds$wh), 
    "embed" = as_factor(subject_preds$embedding_level), 
    "correct" = as.integer(subject_preds$correct),
    "gap_type" = "subject")
  
  
  output <- rbind(object_preds, subject_preds)
  
  output$gap_type <- as_factor(output$gap_type) 
  
  contrasts(output$gap) <- contr.sum(levels(output$gap))
  
  contrasts(output$wh) <- contr.sum(levels(output$wh))
  
  contrasts(output$gap_type) <- contr.sum(levels(output$gap_type))
  
  
  contrasts(output$embed) <- contr.treatment(n = levels(output$embed), base = 1)
  
  return (output)
  
}

gpt.preds <- read_and_combine_dfs(gpt2_object_preds_path, gpt2_subject_preds_path)

head(gpt.preds)
```

## Fit mixed effects model

```{r}

gpt.correctness.model <- glmer(correct ~ wh * embed * gap_type + (1 + wh | id),
                           data = gpt.preds,
                           family = binomial)


```

```{r}
summary(gpt.correctness.model)
```

## Analyse results

average is better for subject, but only because subject consistently predict no-gap, nearly 100% of the time

```{r}


emmeans(gpt.correctness.model, spec = ~ gap_type, type = "response") %>% plot
```

```{r}
emmeans(gpt.correctness.model, spec = ~ gap_type * wh, type = "response") %>% plot
```

Breaking down by gap type: embed only significant for object in combination with wh, somehow significant for subject?

```{r}
joint_tests(gpt.correctness.model, by="gap_type")
```

## GRNN

```{r}
grnn_object_preds_path <- "data/model_outputs/distributions/grnn_wilcox2022_embed4_object_gap_continuation_results.csv"

grnn_subject_preds_path <- "data/model_outputs/distributions/grnn_wilcox2022_embed4_subject_gap_continuation_results.csv"

grnn.preds <- read_and_combine_dfs(grnn_object_preds_path, grnn_subject_preds_path)

```

```{r}

grnn.correctness.model <- glmer(correct ~ wh * embed * gap_type + (1 + wh | id),
                               data = grnn.preds,
                               family = binomial)
```

```{r}

```


```{r}

```

```{r}
joint_tests(gpt.correctness.model, by="gap_type")
```
